title: Sysco Corporation — FDA Enforcement Intelligence
excerpt: Enforcement intelligence profile for Sysco Corporation, the world's largest foodservice distributor, covering 10 recall actions across its 337-facility distribution network. A 14-death Listeria outbreak linked to Sysco-branded nutritional shakes, a $19.4 million California warehouse violations settlement, and a $52 million whistleblower verdict expose systemic food safety risks in the foodservice distribution model.
seo_title: Sysco FDA Recalls & Enforcement Actions | Policy Canary
seo_description: Complete enforcement intelligence on Sysco Corporation: 10 FDA recall actions, 14-death Listeria outbreak from frozen shakes, $19.4M California shed scandal, cesium-137 shrimp contamination, and what it means for foodservice distribution food safety.

key_deadlines.description: FSMA 204 Food Traceability Final Rule takes effect — Sysco has publicly committed to compliance via iFoodDS partnership but must onboard its entire supplier network
